guide_title: From the first install to your daily run.
guide_project_title: Keep the version with the project
guide_project_text: Initialize vfox in Bash and select the project version. With mise, use mise use to select a version for the current project.
faq1_question: How do I find other versions?
faq4_question: How do I update the plugin?
closing_text: Find the source, report an issue or explore the releases on GitHub.
footer_text: An independent vfox plugin documentation site.
hero_description: Install Erlang/OTP with vfox or mise. Use Unix source builds, Windows installers, or prebuilt options for Ubuntu and macOS.
feature1_text: Unix installations build from source by default. Adjust configuration with OTP_CONFIGURE_ARGS.
feature2_text: Ubuntu uses builds for the selected distribution; macOS uses erlef/otp_builds.
feature3_title: A foundation for Erlang and Elixir
feature3_text: Pin Erlang/OTP with vfox or mise, then choose a compatible Elixir version.
linux_deps: Source builds need C/C++ tools, Make, autoconf, m4, ncurses and OpenSSL development libraries. wx, ODBC and documentation features need additional dependencies.
macos_deps: Install Xcode Command Line Tools. Homebrew can supply autoconf, libxslt, fop, wxwidgets and openssl.
windows_deps: The plugin downloads and runs the upstream Erlang/OTP EXE installer. Install and verify from PowerShell.
guide_tools_text: MAKEFLAGS controls parallelism; OTP_CONFIGURE_ARGS is passed to OTP configuration. Use build options supported by the target OTP version.
guide3_text: On Ubuntu, select the target distribution. On macOS, any non-empty USE_PREBUILT_OTP value enables prebuilt mode with architecture detection.
guide3_detail: Keep USE_PREBUILT_OTP consistent for search and installation. Disable the vfox search cache first.
guide3_note: The Ubuntu example is for Ubuntu 22.04 only. Use the matching distribution value elsewhere; on macOS, use USE_PREBUILT_OTP=true.
faq2_question: Does the default installation build from source?
faq2_answer: Linux and macOS build from source by default. Windows uses upstream EXE installers; Unix offers prebuilt modes.
faq3_question: How can I reduce build time?
faq3_answer: Set MAKEFLAGS=-jN for parallel builds, or choose a prebuilt package matching your system and OTP version.
description: Install Erlang/OTP with vfox or mise. Use Unix source builds, Windows installers, or prebuilt options for Ubuntu and macOS.
faq1_answer: Run vfox search erlang or mise ls-remote vfox:version-fox/vfox-erlang to find available versions.
faq4_answer: Run vfox update erlang. The plugin checks the manifest published in this repository.
